kitDescription: Sky is an Iron sniper Supporter with a Burst I. When she holds a full charge for a second, her shots gain Pierce for 40 seconds and she deals 60% more Pierce damage for the same window; the first few holds also hand the whole team a brief immunity to one debuff, three times per battle. Whenever any Full Burst begins she gives every ally a flat ATK boost worth 20% of her own ATK for 10 seconds. Her burst puts the team into High Tension, a stacking 15% Pierce-damage buff for 35 seconds (up to three stacks), and gives herself 50% more ATK for 35 seconds. The catch: when High Tension wears off the team drops into Low Tension, losing 10% of her ATK for 20 seconds, and she herself is stunned (Low Energy) for those 20 seconds. Because her burst cooldown is 40 seconds and High Tension lasts 35, the penalty fires every cycle unless burst cooldown reduction brings her next cast inside the window.

The blind writer assumed liter takes every Burst-1 so sky never casts; under first-ready selection she does cast in controlComp (driver-reported 18.3 s, then re-casts inside 35 s under liter's burst CDR), and the four negative casterAtkPct applies at 53.3 s = 18.3 + 35 are the kit-correct Low Tension lapse. Either way (casts or no casts) there is no model divergence — the blind's own structural assertions on this line (selfStatusEnd /tension/i, allies, casterAtkPct −10, 20 s) are green against the shipped override.

In the modeled Hold world the immunity therefore cannot touch Low Tension, and omitting it is exactly neutral; the caveat's 'a timed hold could cancel up to 3 Low Tension windows' describes a player who saves charges, which contradicts the Hold premise. gotchas.summary: casterAtkPct resolves off static ATK in-engine while the damage-formula SSOT (§1a) states 'caster's final ATK'; sky's +20%-of-ATK team grant is therefore not lifted by her own ATK ▲50% (live at every FB start she opens). Engine-wide convention affecting every caster-ATK buffer, surfaced here because sky pairs a large self-ATK buff with a caster-scaled grant.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'ATK ▲ 20% of the skill user's ATK'. damage-calculation.md §1a: 'convert at application time to a flat add of the caster's final ATK × X'. Driver K3 asserts every positive casterAtkPct value ≈ 0.2 × staticAtk (passes, S2d green) across FB starts that occur 82 frames after her burstCast while her atkPct 50 is live → engine basis is static. Both S2b reviewers flagged this as report-not-act ('if the game uses final ATK the grant is ×1.5 for 35 of every 40 s').
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs an owner ruling or measurement, not a sky edit: popup-compare an ally's FinalATK-driven hit during a Full Burst sky opened (her +50% live) vs one another B1 opened (her +50% lapsed); a ×1.5 difference in the +20% grant's contribution confirms final-ATK basis and the engine's casterAtkPct conversion (and the SSOT wording) must be reconciled roster-wide. Until then, either align §1a's wording to the engine's static basis or record the gap in open-questions.

gotchas.summary: The Low Tension ATK ▼ is verified only at the emitted-buff layer (negative casterAtkPct value, 5 holders, 20 s); no assertion shows an ally's damage actually falls during the window, so a hypothetical zero-clamp on negative flat grants would leave the line modeled-but-inert undetected. Not shown to differ — a verification gap, flagged as PLAUSIBLE.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'Low Tension: ATK ▼ 10% of the skill user's ATK for 20 sec'. §1a effectiveAtk sums caster-ATK grants as flat values with the only clamp at FinalATK = max(0, …), so arithmetic says it works. Driver K4 asserts x.value ≈ −0.1 × staticAtk only; S5 has no behavioural coverage (fixture-unreachable by its premise); S2b fable-5-1 explicitly asked the driver to confirm the engine accepts a negative casterAtkPct without clamping.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Add one damage-side assertion to K4: in fixture A, alice's (or crown's) damage events in [lapse, lapse + 20 s) carry a strictly lower ATK term than the same frames in a run with the −10 effect patched out (or totals for a non-sky ally drop when the effect is present). Green = the negative grant is live; red = declare a GAP, never a fudge.

verdictRationale: All eight kit lines are either FAITHFUL (7) or a DOCUMENTED_GAP (Defiant Spirit, verbatim + caveat); there is no SILENT_DROP, and the two gotchas are low-severity engine-level residuals (the roster-wide casterAtkPct static-vs-final basis, and a missing damage-side assertion for the negative Low Tension grant) that do not block GO. The blind re-derivations converged mechanically after one harness wiring fix (S5 passes onEvent at the wrong level — 3 vacuous REDs): 17 green / 1 RED / 3 skipped, and the lone RED is a RECON_ERROR (the blind assumed sky never casts in controlComp; her cast-plus-35 s lapse is the kit-correct Low Tension). S6's override is block-identical to the driver's modulo a levelScale anchor and the placement of the 35 s High Tension selfStatus, both behaviourally neutral. The new selfStatusEnd primitive is the right shape (burstCast + delaySec is wrong under burst CDR), is independently pinned (engine test 6/6, dispatch-disabled RED, board byte-identical), and the driver's fixture B discriminates it. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing line (mode gate, scope, trigger identity, stack cap, status producer, stun presence). Same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check, ranked: (1) the Hold default for the 'Full Charge maintained 1 s' trigger — all four agents and the driver chose the full-uptime reading, which is a shared prior, not a measurement; Release is one mode switch away and the recipe (focus recording, Pierce icon + shot cadence) is stated; (2) the 'stunned units can still burst' engine convention — in the sole-B1 fixture every re-cast lands inside the 20 s stun, so if the game forbids it her cycle stretches toward ~55 s and all Low Tension timings move; (3) the Defiant Spirit caveat should state that in Hold mode the 3 charges are exhausted in the first ~11–16 s (5 s re-arm gate), so omitting the immunity is exactly neutral to Low Tension uptime rather than a possible ≤3-window cancel; (4) gotcha 1's casterAtkPct basis, which is worth a roster-wide owner ruling independent of sky.
